code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, D-dimer, ferritin). There is also mild hypoalbuminemia, hyperchloremia, and coagulopathy (elevated INR). These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and a risk of coagulopathy. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
